questions.q_en: The height of a triangular wall is 3/7 times its base. If the cost of painting the wall is Rs. 30.5 per m2 is Rs. 1281, then find the height of the wall.
questions.solution_en:
The base of a triangular wall = b

The height of a triangular wall = 3b/7

Area of the wall = ½ X b X 3b/7 = 3b2/14

The cost of painting the wall = 1281 Rs.

3b2/14 = 1281/30.5

b2 = 196

b = 14m

The height of a triangular wall = 3 X 14/7 = 6m

questions.q_en: A boatman goes 2 km against the current of the stream in 1 hour and goes 1 km along the current in 10 minutes. How long will he take to go 5 km in stationary water?
questions.solution_en:
"

Speed of boatman in downstream = (1/10) * 60 km/hr = 6 km/hr

Speed of boatman in upstream = 2 km/hr

Speed of boatman in still water = (1/2) * (6 + 2) = 4 km/hr

Therefore, Required time = (5/4) hrs = 1(1/4) hr = 1 hr 15 min"

questions.q_en: In an election, the winner received 56% of the total voters in the list and 1800 got votes more than his only rival. 20% of voters did not cast their votes, and 480 voters cast their ballots blank. How many voters were on the list?
questions.solution_en:
Let the total number of voters in the voter list be '100X'

The total number of voters who did not vote = 100X * 20/100 = 20X

The total number of voters who supported A = 100X * 56/100 = 56X

The total number of voters who supported B = 56X - 1800

A/Q

56X + 56X - 1800 + 480 = 100X - 20X

32X = 1320

X = 41.25

Hence, the required votes = 41.25 * 100 = 4125

BC = 42/2 = 21 cm

In ∆ABC-

AB2 = BC2 + AC2

(2a + 3)2 = 212 + (a + 7)2

4a2 + 9 + 12a = 441 + a2 + 49 + 14a

3a2 -2a - 481 = 0

3a2 -39a + 37a - 481 = 0

(13a + 37)(a - 13) = 0

a = 13 cm, -37/13

So, a = 13 cm

questions.q_en: In a 5-km race, A beats B by 750 metres and C by 1260 metres. By how many metres does B beat C in the same race?
questions.solution_en:
Let B beat C by T metres.

Length of race course = Distance covered by A = 5 km = 5000 m

Distance covered by B = 5000 - 750 = 4250 m

Distance covered by C = 5000 - 1260 = 3740 m

And

Distance covered by B = 5000 m

Distance covered by C = 5000 - T m

Now,

5000/(5000 - T) = 4250/3740

5000 - T = 4400

T = 600 m

questions.q_en: Maximum value of circumference of a circle inscribed in a square is 176 cm. What is the difference between area of circle and area of square? (take π = 22/7)
questions.solution_en:
Circumference of circle = 2 * (22/7) * radius = 176

Radius = 28 cm

Then, side of square = 2 * 28 = 56 cm

Then, area of square = 56 * 56 = 3136

Area of circle = (22/7) * 28 * 28 = 2464

Therefore, difference = 3136 - 2464 = 672 cm2

questions.q_en: When the integer n is divided by 18, the quotient is x and the remainder is 6. When the integer n is divided by 25, the quotient is y and the remainder is 15. Which of the following is true?
questions.solution_en:
We know dividend = Divisor*quotient + remainder

n = 18x + 6 = 25y + 15.

18x + 6 = 25y + 15

18x - 25y = 15 - 6 = 9.

So 18x -25y = 9

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: The speed of train A is 96 km/h, and it is 760 meters long, then what is the total time taken by train A to cross a 440 meters long bridge and another 1160 meters long train B which is running in the opposite direction at 64 km/h?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken to cross the bridge by train A = (760 + 440)/(96 * 5/18) = 45 seconds

Time taken to cross train B by train A = (760 + 1160)/((96 + 64) * 5/18) = 43.2 seconds

So, total time = 45 + 43.2 = 88.2 seconds

questions.q_en: Marudhar Express and Poorva Express start at the same time from two stations A and B respectively and proceed towards each other at 160 km/h and 190 km/h respectively. When Marudhar Express met Poorva Express, then Marudhar Express had covered 90 km less than Poorva Express had. What is the distance between station A and station B?
questions.solution_en:
Let t be the time(in h) after which they met

Distance traveled by Marudhar Express = Speed * Time = 160 * t = 160t km

Distance traveled by Poorva Express = Speed * Time = 190 * t = 190t km

As the distance covered difference between both trains is 90 km

According to the question,

190t - 160t = 90

=> 30t = 90

=> t = 3 hours

Required Distance = (190 + 160) t = 350 * 3 = 1050 km

questions.q_en: Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P. If AB = 7 cm, CD = 1 cm and PD = 5 cm, then 50% of the length of PA (in cm) is:
questions.solution_en:
Let PB = 'x' cm

We know that: PA * PB = PC * PD

(x + 7) * x = (5 + 1) * 5

x (x + 7) = 30 = 3 * (3 + 7)

After comparing:

x = 3

PA = x + 7 = 10 cm

50% of PA = 5 cm
